# Oven temperature converter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/oven-converter/

Convert Celsius and Fahrenheit and apply an optional fan-oven adjustment. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Convert 180°C conventional heat to Fahrenheit and compare an entered 20°C fan adjustment.

## Limits and checks

Fan adjustments are approximate and oven-dependent. Follow appliance and recipe guidance and check the food during cooking.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
